_note: Devstral Small (24B, Mistral-Small-3.1 base), agentic coding model, text-only, bf16 (~47 GB -> fits one H200; card serves at TP=2). This checkpoint ships ONLY the Mistral tokenizer (tekken.json) + params.json -- NO tokenizer.json / chat_template -- so it MUST be served in mistral format: --tokenizer-mode mistral --config-format mistral --load-format mistral. Tool calling (required by mini-swe-agent) uses --tool-call-parser mistral -- NOT qwen3_coder/glm47; the wrong parser silently zeroes the eval (memory: vllm-tool-parser-gotcha). No reasoning parser (Devstral is an instruct model, not a reasoning model).
_note_serve_cmd: Model card: vllm serve mistralai/Devstral-Small-2505 --tokenizer_mode mistral --config_format mistral --load_format mistral --tool-call-parser mistral --enable-auto-tool-choice --tensor-parallel-size 2 (TP is a node knob, stays in the sbatch TENSOR_PARALLEL, not here).
_note_context: Served window (max_model_len) EQUALS native max_position_embeddings (131072, rope_theta 1e9, no YaRN scaling). Already at the ceiling -- cannot raise without further rope scaling.
